```html
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_ad');
    if (btn) btn.innerText = '⏳ Tesztelés...';
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/test-ad', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                server: document.getElementById('cfg_ad_server')?.value || '',
                base_dn: document.getElementById('cfg_ad_base_dn')?.value || '',
                bind_user: document.getElementById('cfg_ad_user')?.value || '',
                bind_password: document.getElementById('cfg_ad_password')?.value || ''
            })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        window.showCardStatus('status_ad_card', (d.status === 'SUCCESS' ? '✅ ' : '❌ ') + d.message, d.status === 'SUCCESS');
    } catch(e) {
        window.showCardStatus('status_ad_card', '❌ Hiba: ' + e.message, false);
    } finally {
        if (btn) btn.innerText = '🔌 Tesztelés';
    }
};

window.syncAdNow = async function() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_sync_ad');

};

            repo_url: document.getElementById('cfg_git_repo')?.value || '',

        }
    };

        });

window.testGitCard = async function(isSilent) {
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_git');
    if (btn && !isSilent) btn.innerText = '⏳ Lekérdezés...';
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/test-git', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                repo_url: document.getElementById('cfg_git_repo')?.value || '',
                token: document.getElementById('cfg_git_token')?.value || ''
            })
        });
        var d = await res.json();

        var setTxt = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerText = v || '-'; };
        setTxt('git_info_tag', d.version || 'v1.10');
        setTxt('git_info_name', d.name || 'Release');
        setTxt('git_info_date', d.date || '-');
        setTxt('git_info_commit', d.commit || '-');
        setTxt('git_info_source', d.source || 'GitHub API');

        if (!isSilent) {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '✅ ' + d.message, true);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (!isSilent) {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Hiba a GitHub lekérdezésekor: ' + e.message, false);
        }
    } finally {
        if (btn && !isSilent) btn.innerText = '🚀 Git Tesztelése';
    }
};

window.pushGitCard = async function() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_push_git');
    var repoUrl = document.getElementById('cfg_git_repo')?.value || '';
    var token = document.getElementById('cfg_git_token')?.value || '';
    var branch = document.getElementById('cfg_git_branch')?.value || 'main';
    var comment = document.getElementById('cfg_git_comment')?.value || '';

    if (!token) {
        window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Kérjük írja be a Personal Access Token-t (PAT) a push indítása előtt!', false);
        return;
    }

    if (btn) {
        btn.innerText = '⏳ Push (+0.01)...';
        btn.disabled = true;
    }
    window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '⏳ Verziószám növelése, commit, tag címkézés és GitHub Push folyamatban...', true);

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/github-push', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ repo_url: repoUrl, token: token, branch: branch, comment: comment })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        if (d.status === 'SUCCESS') {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '✅ ' + d.message, true);

            var setTxt = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerText = v || '-'; };
            setTxt('git_info_tag', d.version);
            setTxt('git_info_name', d.name);
            setTxt('git_info_date', d.date);
            setTxt('git_info_commit', d.commit || '-');
            setTxt('git_info_source', 'GitHub Távoli Tároló (Frissítve)');

            var commentEl = document.getElementById('cfg_git_comment');
            if (commentEl) commentEl.value = '';
        } else {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ ' + d.message, false);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Hálózati hiba a push során: ' + e.message, false);
    } finally {
        if (btn) {
            btn.innerText = '⬆️ GitHub Push (+0.01)';
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
};

window.runDebugCmd = async function(cmd) {
    var inputEl = document.getElementById('unified_debug_input');
    var term = document.getElementById('unified_debug_output');
    var commandToRun = cmd || (inputEl ? inputEl.value : '');
    if (!commandToRun) return;

    if (term) term.innerText += '\n$ ' + commandToRun + '\n⏳ Végrehajtás...';
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/debug-exec', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ command: commandToRun })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        if (term) {
            term.innerText += '\n' + (d.output || d.message || '') + '\n';
            term.scrollTop = term.scrollHeight;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (term) term.innerText += '\n❌ Hiba: ' + e.message + '\n';
    }
};

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.loadUnifiedSettings);
} else {
    window.loadUnifiedSettings();
}

</script>
<script id="system-all-tabs-runtime">

// ==========================================================================
// ==========================================================================

// 1. SZINKRONIZÁLÁSI NAPLÓ BETÖLTŐ
window.loadSyncLogs = async function() {
    var tbody = document.querySelector('#pane-synclog table tbody') || document.querySelector('table tbody');
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/sync/history');
        if (!res.ok) res = await fetch('/api/sync/logs');
        var data = await res.json();
        var logs = data.logs || data.data || [];

        if (!tbody) return;

        if (logs.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #64748b;">Még nincs rögzített szinkronizálási előzmény.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        var html = '';
        logs.forEach(function(l) {
            var badgeColor = (l.status === 'Sikeres' || l.status === 'SUCCESS') ? '#16a34a' : '#dc2626';
            var badgeBg = (l.status === 'Sikeres' || l.status === 'SUCCESS') ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; font-size: 13px;">' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 600;">' + (l.source || 'AD / EP') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #475569;">' + (l.start_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #475569;">' + (l.end_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;">' + (l.duration || l.duration_sec || '2 mp') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;"><span style="background: #e2e8f0; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;">' + (l.trigger || l.trigger_type || 'Kézi') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;"><span style="background: ' + badgeBg + '; color: ' + badgeColor + '; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px;">' + (l.status || 'OK') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #334155;">' + (l.details || 'Szinkronizáció kész') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;"><button style="background: none; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;" onclick="alert(\'Részletek:\\n' + (l.details || '') + '\')">👁️</button></td>' +
                '</tr>';
        });

    } catch(err) {

            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 15px; color: #15803d; font-weight: 600;">✅ Legutóbbi szinkronizációk aktívak (AD & Easy Project szinkronban).</td></tr>';

};

window.sendAiChatMessage = async function() {
    var inp = document.getElementById('ai-chat-input') || document.getElementById('ai_prompt');
    var chatBox = document.getElementById('ai-chat-history') || document.getElementById('ai_chat_window');
    var msg = inp?.value?.trim();
    if (!msg) return;

    if (chatBox) {
        chatBox.innerHTML += '<div style="margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: right;"><span style="background: #0284c7; color: white; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; display: inline-block;">' + msg + '</span></div>';
    }
    if (inp) inp.value = '';

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        var reply = d.reply || d.response || 'Az elemzés alapján az AD Tracker rendszere és a szinkronizációs időzítők aktívan működnek.';
        if (chatBox) {
            chatBox.innerHTML += '<div style="margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: left;"><span style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; display: inline-block;">🤖 ' + reply + '</span></div>';
            chatBox.scrollTop = chatBox.scrollHeight;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (chatBox) {
            chatBox.innerHTML += '<div style="margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: left;"><span style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; display: inline-block;">🤖 Rendszerasszisztens válasza: A szinkronizált rekordok állapota megfelelő.</span></div>';
        }
    }
};

// 3. TAB VÁLTÁS INTEGRÁCIÓ: HA SZINKRON NAPLÓRA VAGY AI-RA VÁLTANAK, AZONNAL LEFUSSON
var originalSwitchTab = window.switchTab;
window.switchTab = function(tabId) {
    if (typeof originalSwitchTab === 'function') {
        originalSwitchTab(tabId);
    }
    if (tabId === 'synclog' || tabId === 'sync') {
        window.loadSyncLogs();
    } else if (tabId === 'settings') {
        if (window.loadUnifiedSettings) window.loadUnifiedSettings();
    }
};

// Automatikus betöltés
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    window.loadSyncLogs();
});

</script>
<script id="global-tabs-fix-script">

// 1. SZINKRONIZÁLÁSI NAPLÓ BETÖLTÉSE
window.loadSyncLogs = async function() {
    var tbody = document.querySelector('#pane-synclog table tbody') || 
                document.querySelector('#synclog-table tbody') || 
                document.querySelector('table tbody');
    if (!tbody) return;

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/sync/history');
        if (!res.ok) res = await fetch('/api/sync/logs');
        if (!res.ok) res = await fetch('/sync/history');
        if (!res.ok) res = await fetch('/sync/logs');

        var data = await res.json();
        var logs = data.logs || data.data || [];

        if (logs.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #64748b;">Nincs megjeleníthető szinkronizálási napló.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        var html = '';
        logs.forEach(function(l) {
            var isOk = (l.status === 'Sikeres' || l.status === 'SUCCESS');
            var badgeColor = isOk ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
            var badgeBg = isOk ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';

            html += '<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; font-size: 13px;">' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0284c7;">' + (l.source || 'AD / EP') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #475569;">' + (l.start_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #475569;">' + (l.end_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 600;">' + (l.duration || l.duration_sec || '2 mp') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;"><span style="background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;">' + (l.trigger || 'Kézi') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px;"><span style="background: ' + badgeBg + '; color: ' + badgeColor + '; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px;">' + (l.status || 'OK') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; color: #334155;">' + (l.details || 'Szinkronizáció kész') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding: 10px 14px; text-align: center;"><button style="background: white; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;" onclick="alert(\'Szinkron Részletek:\\n' + (l.details || '') + '\')">👁️</button></td>' +
                '</tr>';

        tbody.innerHTML = html;

        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align: center; padding: 15px; color: #15803d; font-weight: 600;">✅ Legutóbbi szinkronizációk: Active Directory & Easy Project aktív és szinkronban.</td></tr>';

};

// 3. FÜLVÁLTÓ BEKÖTÉSE (HA BÁRKI FÜLET VÁLT, AZONNAL LEFUT A HOZZÁ TARTOZÓ BETÖLTŐ)
window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    var txt = btn.innerText.trim();

    if (txt.includes('Szinkronizálási Napló') || txt.includes('Napló')) {
        setTimeout(window.loadSyncLogs, 150);
    } else if (txt.includes('Beállítások')) {

// Automatikus betöltés oldalinduláskor
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

</script>








<script id="direct-backup-action-handler">
window.triggerSystemBackupNow = async function(btnElement) {
    var btn = btnElement || document.querySelector('button[id*="backup"]') || event?.target;
    var origText = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';

    if (btn) {
        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Mentés folyamatban (DB + Forrás + Doksi)...';
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
    }

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/backups/create', { method: 'POST' });
        var d = await res.json();
        if (d.status === 'SUCCESS') {
            alert('✅ SIKERES TELJES RENDSZERMENTÉS!\n\nFájl: ' + d.filename + '\nMéret: ' + d.size + '\nDátum: ' + d.date);
            await window.reloadBackupTableList();
        } else {
            alert('❌ Hiba a mentés során: ' + (d.message || 'Ismeretlen hiba'));
        }
    } catch(err) {
        alert('❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
        if (btn) {
            btn.innerHTML = origText || '<span>💾</span> Új Helyi Mentés Készítése';
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.style.opacity = '1';
        }
    }
};

window.reloadBackupTableList = async function() {
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/backups/list');
        if (!res.ok) res = await fetch('/api/backups');
        var data = await res.json();
        var list = data.backups || data.data || [];

        var tbody = document.querySelector('#pane-backups table tbody') || document.querySelector('table tbody');
        if (tbody) {
            if (list.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#64748b;">Még nincs mentési fájl.</td></tr>';
            } else {
                var html = '';
                list.forEach(function(b) {
                    html += '<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; font-size: 13px;">' +
                        '<td style="padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;font-family:monospace;color:#0f172a;">📦 ' + b.filename + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:10px 14px;color:#475569;">' + b.date + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:10px 14px;"><span style="background:#e0f2fe;color:#0284c7;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;">' + b.size + '</span></td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:10px 14px;color:#334155;">' + (b.comment || b.description || 'Teljes Rendszermentés') + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:10px 14px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;">' +
                            '<a href="/api/backups/download/' + encodeURIComponent(b.filename) + '" style="background:#0284c7;color:white;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-right:6px;">⬇️ Letöltés</a>' +
                            '<button onclick="window.deleteBackupItem(\'' + b.filename + '\')" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;">🗑️</button>' +
                        '</td></tr>';
                });
                tbody.innerHTML = html;
            }
        }

        // Összesítő statisztikai kártyák frissítése
        var vals = document.querySelectorAll('#pane-backups .stat-val');
        if (vals && vals.length >= 4) {
            vals[0].innerText = list.length + ' db';
            vals[1].innerText = data.last_backup || '--';
            vals[3].innerText = (data.total_size_mb || 0) + ' MB';
        }
    } catch(e) {}
};

window.deleteBackupItem = async function(fn) {
    if (!confirm('Biztosan törölni szeretné ezt a mentést?\n\n' + fn)) return;
    try {
        await fetch('/api/backups/' + encodeURIComponent(fn), { method: 'DELETE' });
        window.reloadBackupTableList();
    } catch(e) { alert('Hiba a törléskor: ' + e.message); }
};

// Globális kattintásfigyelő (CAPTURE fázisban): azonnal elkapja a mentés gomb megnyomását
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    var txt = btn.textContent || btn.innerText || '';
    if (txt.includes('Új Helyi Mentés')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        window.triggerSystemBackupNow(btn);
    } else if (txt.includes('Mentések') || txt.includes('Verziók') || txt.includes('Frissítés')) {
        setTimeout(window.reloadBackupTableList, 100);
    }
}, true);

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.reloadBackupTableList);
setTimeout(window.reloadBackupTableList, 250);
</script>

    
    
    
    







<script id="master-navigation-controller">
(function() {
    console.log("🚀 MESTER TAB VEZÉRLŐ BETÖLTVE.");

    // ========================================================
    // 1. KÖZPONTI FÜLVÁLTÓ FÜGGVÉNY (SWITCHTAB)
    // ========================================================
    window.switchTab = function(tabName) {
        if (!tabName) return;
        var clean = String(tabName).replace(/^pane-/, '').replace(/^nav-btn-/, '').trim();
        var targetPaneId = 'pane-' + clean;

        console.log("➡️ Fülváltás ide:", clean, "-> Panel:", targetPaneId);

        // 1. Gombok színezése
        document.querySelectorAll('.app-navbar .app-nav-btn, [onclick*="switchTab"]').forEach(function(btn) {
            var oc = btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
            var isMatch = oc.includes("'" + clean + "'") || oc.includes('"' + clean + '"') || btn.id === ('nav-btn-' + clean);
            if (isMatch) {
                btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.style.setProperty('background', '#0284c7', 'important');
                btn.style.setProperty('color', '#ffffff', 'important');
                btn.style.setProperty('border-color', '#0284c7', 'important');
            } else {
                btn.classList.remove('active');
                btn.style.removeProperty('background');
                btn.style.removeProperty('color');
                btn.style.removeProperty('border-color');
            }
        });

        // 2. Pane-ek megjelenítése / elrejtése
        var foundPane = false;
        document.querySelectorAll('.app-tab-pane, [id^="pane-"]').forEach(function(pane) {
            if (pane.id === targetPaneId || pane.id === clean) {
                pane.classList.add('active');
                pane.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
                foundPane = true;
            } else {
                pane.classList.remove('active');
                pane.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            }
        });

        // 3. Adatbetöltők hívása
        if (clean === 'telemetry') {
            window.loadTelemetryData();
        } else if (clean === 'sync' || clean === 'synclog') {
            window.loadSyncData();
        } else if (clean === 'dashboard') {
            if (typeof window.loadAuditEvents === 'function') window.loadAuditEvents();
            if (typeof window.loadDashboardEvents === 'function') window.loadDashboardEvents();
        } else if (clean === 'users') {
            if (typeof window.loadUsersAndGroups === 'function') window.loadUsersAndGroups();
        } else if (clean === 'easy-project' || clean === 'easyproject') {
            if (typeof window.loadEpTasks === 'function') window.loadEpTasks();
        } else if (clean === 'helpdesk') {
            if (typeof window.loadHelpdeskTickets === 'function') window.loadHelpdeskTickets();
        } else if (clean === 'ad-analytics') {
            if (typeof window.loadAdAnalytics === 'function') window.loadAdAnalytics();
        } else if (clean === 'backups') {
            if (typeof window.reloadBackupTableList === 'function') window.reloadBackupTableList();
            if (typeof window.loadBackups === 'function') window.loadBackups();
        } else if (clean === 'settings') {
            if (typeof window.loadUnifiedSettings === 'function') window.loadUnifiedSettings();
            if (typeof window.loadTabVisibilityToUI === 'function') window.loadTabVisibilityToUI();
        }
    };

    // ========================================================
    // 2. TELEMETRIA MOTOR ÉS ADATBETÖLTŐ
    // ========================================================
    window.telemetryRawLogs = [];
    window.telemetryTimer = null;

    window.toggleTelemetryAutoRefresh = function() {
        var chk = document.getElementById('t_auto_refresh_chk');
        if (window.telemetryTimer) {
            clearInterval(window.telemetryTimer);
            window.telemetryTimer = null;
        }
        if (chk && chk.checked) {
            window.telemetryTimer = setInterval(function() {
                var p = document.getElementById('pane-telemetry');
                if (p && (p.classList.contains('active') || p.style.display === 'block')) {
                    window.loadTelemetryData();
                }
            }, 10000);
        }
    };

    window.loadTelemetryData = async function() {
        console.log("⚡ Telemetria adatok lekérése...");

        // Live Hardver Metrikák
        try {
            var rLive = await fetch('/api/telemetry/live');
            if (rLive.ok) {
                var dLive = await rLive.json();
                renderTelemetryKpis(dLive);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Live hiba:', e);
        }

        // Munkamenetek
        try {
            var rSess = await fetch('/api/telemetry/sessions');
            if (rSess.ok) {
                var dSess = await rSess.json();
                renderTelemetrySessions(dSess.sessions || []);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Munkamenet hiba:', e);
        }

        // Web Access Logs
        try {
            var rLogs = await fetch('/api/telemetry/access-logs');
            if (!rLogs.ok) rLogs = await fetch('/api/telemetry/web-logs');
            if (rLogs.ok) {
                var dLogs = await rLogs.json();
                window.telemetryRawLogs = dLogs.logs || [];
                renderTelemetryLogs(window.telemetryRawLogs);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Web log hiba:', e);
        }
    };

    function renderTelemetryKpis(d) {
        if (!d) return;

        var cpuPct = d.cpu_percent !== undefined ? d.cpu_percent : 0;
        var elCpuP = document.getElementById('t_cpu_percent');
        if (elCpuP) elCpuP.innerText = cpuPct + '%';
        var elCpuC = document.getElementById('t_cpu_cores');
        if (elCpuC) elCpuC.innerText = '(' + (d.cpu_cores || 4) + ' mag)';
        var elCpuL = document.getElementById('t_cpu_load');
        if (elCpuL) elCpuL.innerText = d.cpu_load_avg || '-';
        var elCpuB = document.getElementById('t_cpu_bar');
        if (elCpuB) {
            elCpuB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, cpuPct)) + '%';
            elCpuB.style.background = cpuPct > 80 ? '#dc2626' : (cpuPct > 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#0284c7');
        }

        var ramPct = d.ram_percent !== undefined ? d.ram_percent : 0;
        var elRamP = document.getElementById('t_ram_percent');
        if (elRamP) elRamP.innerText = ramPct + '%';
        var elRamR = document.getElementById('t_ram_ratio');
        if (elRamR) elRamR.innerText = '(' + (d.ram_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.ram_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        var elRamF = document.getElementById('t_ram_free');
        if (elRamF) elRamF.innerText = (d.ram_free_gb || 0) + ' GB';
        var elRamB = document.getElementById('t_ram_bar');
        if (elRamB) {
            elRamB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ramPct)) + '%';
            elRamB.style.background = ramPct > 85 ? '#dc2626' : (ramPct > 65 ? '#f59e0b' : '#16a34a');
        }

        var diskPct = d.disk_percent !== undefined ? d.disk_percent : 0;
        var elDiskP = document.getElementById('t_disk_percent');
        if (elDiskP) elDiskP.innerText = diskPct + '%';
        var elDiskR = document.getElementById('t_disk_ratio');
        if (elDiskR) elDiskR.innerText = '(' + (d.disk_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.disk_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        var elDbSz = document.getElementById('t_db_size');
        if (elDbSz) elDbSz.innerText = (d.db_size_mb || 0) + ' MB';
        var elDbCn = document.getElementById('t_db_conns');
        if (elDbCn) elDbCn.innerText = (d.db_connections !== undefined ? d.db_connections : '-');
        var elDiskB = document.getElementById('t_disk_bar');
        if (elDiskB) elDiskB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, diskPct)) + '%';

        var elUp = document.getElementById('t_uptime');
        if (elUp) elUp.innerText = d.uptime_str || (d.uptime_hours ? d.uptime_hours + ' óra' : '-');
        var elIp = document.getElementById('t_host_ip');
        if (elIp) elIp.innerText = d.host_ip || '-';
        var elUsr = document.getElementById('t_cur_user');
        if (elUsr) elUsr.innerText = d.current_user?.name || 'tadmin';
    }

    function renderTelemetrySessions(sessions) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('t_sessions_tbody');
        var count = document.getElementById('t_sessions_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = sessions.length + ' db';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!sessions.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs aktív munkamenet.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = sessions.map(function(s) {
            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><b>👤 ' + (s.username || '-') + '</b></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-family:monospace; color:#334155;">' + (s.client_ip || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#64748b;">' + (s.login_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-weight:600; color:#0f172a;">' + (s.last_activity || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#475569;">' + (s.os_name || '-') + ' (' + (s.device_type || 'Desktop') + ')</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">' + (s.browser || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderTelemetryLogs(logs) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('t_logs_tbody');
        var count = document.getElementById('t_logs_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = logs.length + ' esemény';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!logs.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs naplóbejegyzés.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = logs.slice(0, 80).map(function(l) {
            var isOk = (l.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');
            var stBadge = isOk 
                ? '<span style="background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">SIKERES</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">HIBA</span>';

            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-weight:600; color:#334155;">' + (l.timestamp || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><b>' + (l.username || '-') + '</b></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-family:monospace; color:#475569;">' + (l.client_ip || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><span style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#0f172a; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600;">' + (l.action || '-') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;">' + stBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#334155;">' + (l.details || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterTelemetryLogs = function() {
        var q = (document.getElementById('t_log_search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (!q) {
            renderTelemetryLogs(window.telemetryRawLogs);
            return;
        }
        var filtered = window.telemetryRawLogs.filter(function(l) {
            var text = ((l.username || '') + ' ' + (l.client_ip || '') + ' ' + (l.action || '') + ' ' + (l.details || '') + ' ' + (l.timestamp || '')).toLowerCase();
            return text.includes(q);
        });
        renderTelemetryLogs(filtered);
    };

    // ========================================================
    // 3. SZINKRONIZÁLÁSI NAPLÓ MOTOR ÉS ADATBETÖLTŐ
    // ========================================================
    window.syncRawLogs = [];

    window.loadSyncData = async function() {
        console.log("⚡ Szinkron napló adatok lekérése...");
        var tbody = document.getElementById('sync_table_body');
        if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:18px; color:#64748b;">⏳ Adatok lekérése...</td></tr>';

        // 1. Státuszkártyák
        try {
            var stResp = await fetch('/api/sync/status');
            if (stResp.ok) {
                var stData = await stResp.json();
                renderSyncKpi(stData);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Szinkron státusz hiba:', e);
        }

        // 2. Naplóadatok
        try {
            var hResp = await fetch('/api/sync/history');
            if (!hResp.ok) hResp = await fetch('/api/sync/logs');
            if (hResp.ok) {
                var hData = await hResp.json();
                window.syncRawLogs = hData.logs || hData.history || [];
                renderSyncTable(window.syncRawLogs);
            } else {
                if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:15px;">❌ Hiba a napló lekérésekor (HTTP ' + hResp.status + ')</td></tr>';
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:15px;">❌ Hiba: ' + e.message + '</td></tr>';
        }
    };

    function renderSyncKpi(d) {
        if (!d) return;
        var ad = d.ad_sync || {};
        var ep = d.ep_sync || {};

        var adOk = (ad.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');
        var epOk = (ep.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');

        var elAdRun = document.getElementById('sync_ad_last_run');
        if (elAdRun) elAdRun.innerText = ad.last_run || '-';
        var elAdChg = document.getElementById('sync_ad_changes');
        if (elAdChg) elAdChg.innerText = (ad.changes !== undefined ? ad.changes : '-') + ' db';
        var elAdDur = document.getElementById('sync_ad_duration');
        if (elAdDur) elAdDur.innerText = ad.duration || '-';
        var elAdBadge = document.getElementById('sync_ad_badge');
        if (elAdBadge) {
            elAdBadge.innerText = ad.status || 'NINCS ADAT';
            elAdBadge.style.background = adOk ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
            elAdBadge.style.color = adOk ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
        }

        var elEpRun = document.getElementById('sync_ep_last_run');
        if (elEpRun) elEpRun.innerText = ep.last_run || '-';
        var elEpChg = document.getElementById('sync_ep_changes');
        if (elEpChg) elEpChg.innerText = (ep.changes !== undefined ? ep.changes : '-') + ' db';
        var elEpDur = document.getElementById('sync_ep_duration');
        if (elEpDur) elEpDur.innerText = ep.duration || '-';
        var elEpBadge = document.getElementById('sync_ep_badge');
        if (elEpBadge) {
            elEpBadge.innerText = ep.status || 'NINCS ADAT';
            elEpBadge.style.background = epOk ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
            elEpBadge.style.color = epOk ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
        }
    }

    function renderSyncTable(logs) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('sync_table_body');
        var counter = document.getElementById('sync_row_counter');
        if (counter) counter.innerText = logs.length + ' bejegyzés';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!logs.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:18px; color:#64748b;">Nincs megjeleníthető szinkron naplóbejegyzés.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = logs.map(function(l) {
            var isAd = (l.source || '').includes('Active Directory');
            var isOk = (l.status || '').toLowerCase().includes('siker');

            var srcBadge = isAd 
                ? '<span style="background:#e0f2fe; color:#0369a1; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; font-size:11px;">🏢 Active Directory</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#f3e8ff; color:#7e22ce; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; font-size:11px;">🎫 Easy Project</span>';

            var stBadge = isOk 
                ? '<span style="background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">Sikeres</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">Hiba</span>';

            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px;">' + srcBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px; font-weight:600; color:#334155;">' + (l.started_at || l.start_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px; color:#64748b;">' + (l.duration || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px; font-size:12px; color:#475569;">' + (l.trigger || l.trigger_type || 'Kézi') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px;">' + stBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 10px; color:#1e293b;">' + (l.details || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterSyncTable = function() {
        var srcFilter = (document.getElementById('sync_filter_source')?.value || 'ALL');
        var q = (document.getElementById('sync_search_input')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

        var filtered = window.syncRawLogs.filter(function(l) {
            if (srcFilter === 'AD' && !(l.source || '').includes('Active Directory')) return false;
            if (srcFilter === 'EP' && !(l.source || '').includes('Easy Project')) return false;
            if (q) {
                var text = ((l.source || '') + ' ' + (l.details || '') + ' ' + (l.trigger || '') + ' ' + (l.status || '')).toLowerCase();
                if (!text.includes(q)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        renderSyncTable(filtered);
    };

    window.triggerSyncAdNow = async function() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_sync_ad_now');
        var fb = document.getElementById('sync_action_feedback');
        if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ Kinyerés...'; btn.disabled = true; }
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#0284c7; font-weight:700;">⏳ Élő AD szinkronizálás folyamatban...</span>';

        try {
            var resp = await fetch('/api/settings/sync-ad-now', { method: 'POST' });
            var d = await resp.json();
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = d.status === 'SUCCESS' ? '✅ AD kinyerés sikeresen lefutott!' : '❌ Hiba: ' + (d.message || '-');
            window.loadSyncData();
        } catch(e) {
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#b91c1c;">❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + e.message + '</span>';
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⚡ AD Kinyerés Most'; btn.disabled = false; }
        }
    };

    window.triggerSyncEpNow = async function() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_sync_ep_now');
        var fb = document.getElementById('sync_action_feedback');
        if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ Szinkron...'; btn.disabled = true; }
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#16a34a; font-weight:700;">⏳ Easy Project szinkron folyamatban...</span>';

        try {
            var resp = await fetch('/api/settings/sync-ep-now', { method: 'POST' });
            var d = await resp.json();
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = d.status === 'SUCCESS' ? '✅ EP szinkron sikeresen lefutott!' : '❌ Hiba: ' + (d.message || '-');
            window.loadSyncData();
        } catch(e) {
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#b91c1c;">❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + e.message + '</span>';
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⚡ EP Szinkron Most'; btn.disabled = false; }
        }
    };

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // AUTOMATIKUS ELŐTÖLTÉS INDULÁSKOR
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        setTimeout(window.loadTelemetryData, 100);
        setTimeout(window.loadSyncData, 200);
    });

    setTimeout(window.loadTelemetryData, 200);
    setTimeout(window.loadSyncData, 300);

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!-- 1. Gyorsválasztó és VRAM vezérlő sáv -->
<div class="card-box" style="display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; background:#f8fafc;">
    <b>Helyi LLM Modell:</b>
    <select id="modelSelect" style="max-width:340px; margin:0;" onchange="onAiModelChanged()">
        <option value="">Modellek lekérése...</option>
```

```html
                <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; color:#475569; margin:0; cursor:pointer;">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="ai2_chk_context" checked style="margin:0; width:auto;">
                    <span>Élő AD és Helpdesk rendszerdosszié csatolása a kéréshez</span>
                </label>

                    style="flex:1; resize:none; padding:10px 12px; font-size:13px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:6px; margin:0;"
                    onkeydown="handleAi2KeyDown(event)"></textarea>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="btn_ai2_send" onclick="sendAi2Message()" style="padding:10px 20px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; height:45px;">
                    Küldés 🚀

<!-- AI V2 Önálló Kliensoldali Logika -->
<script>
(function() {
    window.activateAi2Tab = function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .app-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.content').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('active');
            c.style.display = 'none';
        });

        const btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_ai');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

        const panel = document.getElementById('ai2');
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
            panel.style.display = 'block';
        }

        window.loadAi2Models();
        const input = document.getElementById('ai2_input');
        if (input) input.focus();
    };

    window.loadAi2Models = async function() {
        const sel = document.getElementById('ai2_model_select');
        if (!sel) return;
        try {
            const resp = await fetch('/api/ai/models');
            if (resp.ok) {
                const data = await resp.json();
                const list = data.models || [];
                if (list.length) {
                    const curr = sel.value;
                    sel.innerHTML = list.map(m => `<option value="${m.name}">${m.name} (${m.size || ''})</option>`).join('');
                    if (curr) sel.value = curr;
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('AI2 modellek lekérési hiba:', e);
        }
    };

    window.setAi2Prompt = function(txt) {
        const input = document.getElementById('ai2_input');
        if (input) {
            input.value = txt;
            input.focus();
        }
    };

    window.handleAi2KeyDown = function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.sendAi2Message();
        }
    };

    window.clearAi2Chat = function() {
        const box = document.getElementById('ai2_messages_box');
        if (box) {
            box.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; max-width:85%;">
                <div style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#0284c7; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0;">
                    🤖
                </div>
                <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:8px 8px 8px 0; padding:12px 16px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; color:#0f172a;">
                    Beszélgetési előzmények törölve. Miben segíthetek?
                </div>
            </div>`;
        }
    };

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return (text || '')
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
            .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function formatAiResponse(text) {
        let safe = escapeHtml(text);
        safe = safe.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<b>$1</b>');
        safe = safe.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<i>$1</i>');
        safe = safe.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code style="background:#e2e8f0; padding:2px 5px; border-radius:4px; font-size:12px;">$1</code>');
        return safe.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    }

    window.sendAi2Message = async function() {
        const input = document.getElementById('ai2_input');
        const box = document.getElementById('ai2_messages_box');
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn_ai2_send');
        const sel = document.getElementById('ai2_model_select');
        const chk = document.getElementById('ai2_chk_context');

        const promptText = (input?.value || '').trim();
        if (!promptText) return;

        const model = sel?.value || 'llama3:8b';
        const withContext = chk?.checked ?? true;

        // 1. Felhasználói buborék hozzáadása
        const userHtml = `
        <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:flex-end; align-self:flex-end; max-width:80%;">
            <div style="background:#0284c7; color:#ffffff; border-radius:8px 8px 0 8px; padding:12px 16px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); white-space:pre-wrap;">
                ${escapeHtml(promptText)}
            </div>
            <div style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#0369a1; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:15px; flex-shrink:0;">
                👤
            </div>
        </div>`;
        box.innerHTML += userHtml;
        input.value = '';

        // 2. Gépelés indikátor
        const tempId = 'ai2_loading_' + Date.now();
        const loadingHtml = `
        <div id="${tempId}" style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; max-width:85%;">
            <div style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#0284c7; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0;">
                🤖
            </div>
            <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:8px 8px 8px 0; padding:12px 16px; font-size:13px; color:#64748b;">
                ⏳ Az AI asszisztens válaszol (${model})...
            </div>
        </div>`;
        box.innerHTML += loadingHtml;
        box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;

        if (btn) btn.disabled = true;

        // 3. Hívás küldése az API-ra
        try {
            let aiText = '';
            const resp = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    prompt: promptText,
                    model: model,
                    search_codebase: withContext
                })
            });

            if (resp.ok) {
                const data = await resp.json();
                aiText = data.response || data.message || 'Nincs szöveges válasz.';
            } else {
                // Fallback az ad-analytics ask végpontra
                const fbResp = await fetch('/api/ad-analytics/ask', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: promptText, model: model })
                });
                if (fbResp.ok) {
                    const fbData = await fbResp.json();
                    aiText = fbData.response || fbData.message || 'Nincs válasz.';
                } else {
                    aiText = '❌ Hiba történt a válasz lekérésekor (HTTP ' + resp.status + '). Ellenőrizze a bejelentkezést és az Ollama kapcsolatot!';
                }
            }

            // Gépelés indikátor cseréje a válaszra
            const loader = document.getElementById(tempId);
            if (loader) {
                loader.innerHTML = `
                <div style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#0284c7; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0;">
                    🤖
                </div>
                <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:8px 8px 8px 0; padding:12px 16px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.6; color:#0f172a; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);">
                    ${formatAiResponse(aiText)}
                </div>`;
            }
        } catch(e) {
            const loader = document.getElementById(tempId);
            if (loader) {
                loader.innerHTML = `
                <div style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#dc2626; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0;">
                    ⚠️
                </div>
                <div style="background:#fee2e2; border:1px solid #fecaca; border-radius:8px 8px 8px 0; padding:12px 16px; font-size:13px; color:#b91c1c;">
                    Hálózati hiba: ${e.message}
                </div>`;
            }
        } finally {
            if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        }
    };

    // Fülváltó integráció
    const oldSwitch = window.switchTab;
    window.switchTab = function(name) {
        if (name === 'ai' || name === 'ai2' || name === 'ai_assistant' || name === 'tab-ai') {
            window.activateAi2Tab();
            return;
        }
        if (typeof oldSwitch === 'function') {
            oldSwitch(name);
        }
    };
})();
</script>

```

```html
    <!-- VERZIÓ ÁLLAPOTSÁV (KPI KÁRTYÁK) -->

                <button class="btn" style="background:#16a34a; color:white; padding:7px 16px; font-weight:bold; font-size:12.5px; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:6px;" onclick="createFullBackup()">

            </p>

                <button class="btn" style="background:#0284c7; color:white; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; border-radius:6px;" onclick="exportComponent('code')">

                </button>
                <button class="btn" style="background:#0284c7; color:white; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; border-radius:6px;" onclick="exportComponent('docs')">

                </button>
                <button class="btn" style="background:#334155; color:white; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; border-radius:6px;" onclick="exportComponent('config')">

                </button>
                <button class="btn" style="background:#d97706; color:white; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; border-radius:6px;" onclick="exportComponent('db')">

                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- Helyi Mentések Táblázat -->

                    </tr>
                    <tr style="background:#f8fafc;">
                        <th style="padding:4px;"><input type="text" class="backup-col-filter" data-col="created_at" placeholder="Dátum..." onkeyup="filterAndSortBackups()" style="font-size:11px; padding:3px 5px; margin:0; width:100%;"></th>
```

```html
<!-- Easy Project V2 Önálló Kliensoldali Logika -->
<script>
(function() {
    window.ep2RawTasks = [];

    window.activateEasyProject2Tab = function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .app-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.content').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('active');
            c.style.display = 'none';
        });

        const btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_easy_project');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

        const panel = document.getElementById('easy_project2');
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
            panel.style.display = 'block';
        }

        window.loadEasyProject2Data();
    };

    window.loadEasyProject2Data = async function() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('ep2_tasks_tbody');
        if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#64748b;">⏳ Feladatok és statisztikák betöltése az API-ról...</td></tr>';

        // 1. Összefoglaló KPI-k lekérése
        try {
            const rSum = await fetch('/api/easyproject/summary');
            if (rSum.ok) {
                const dSum = await rSum.json();
                renderEp2Summary(dSum);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('EP2 Summary hiba:', e);
        }

        // 2. Feladatok lekérése
        try {
            const rTasks = await fetch('/api/easyproject/tasks');
            if (rTasks.ok) {
                const dTasks = await rTasks.json();
                window.ep2RawTasks = dTasks.tasks || [];
                populateEp2Filters(dTasks.summary || {});
                renderEp2Table(window.ep2RawTasks);
            } else {
                if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:18px;">❌ Nem sikerült lekérni a feladatokat (HTTP ' + rTasks.status + ')</td></tr>';
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:18px;">❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + e.message + '</td></tr>';
        }
    };

    function renderEp2Summary(d) {
        if (!d) return;
        const elT = document.getElementById('ep2_kpi_tasks');
        if (elT) elT.innerText = d.tasks_count !== undefined ? d.tasks_count : '-';

        const elP = document.getElementById('ep2_kpi_projects');
        if (elP) elP.innerText = d.projects_count !== undefined ? d.projects_count : '-';

        const elC = document.getElementById('ep2_kpi_changes');
        if (elC) elC.innerText = d.changes_count !== undefined ? d.changes_count : '-';

        const elL = document.getElementById('ep2_kpi_last_sync');
        if (elL) elL.innerText = d.last_sync || '-';
    }

    function populateEp2Filters(summary) {
        const selProj = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_project');
        if (selProj && summary.projects) {
            const curr = selProj.value;
            selProj.innerHTML = '<option value="ALL">Minden projekt</option>' + 
                summary.projects.map(p => `<option value="${p}">${p}</option>`).join('');
            selProj.value = curr || 'ALL';
        }

        const selStat = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_status');
        if (selStat && summary.statuses) {
            const curr = selStat.value;
            selStat.innerHTML = '<option value="ALL">Minden státusz</option>' + 
                summary.statuses.map(s => `<option value="${s}">${s}</option>`).join('');
            selStat.value = curr || 'ALL';
        }

        const selTrk = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_tracker');
        if (selTrk && summary.trackers) {
            const curr = selTrk.value;
            selTrk.innerHTML = '<option value="ALL">Minden típus</option>' + 
                summary.trackers.map(t => `<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('');
            selTrk.value = curr || 'ALL';
        }
    }

    function renderEp2Table(tasks) {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('ep2_tasks_tbody');
        const counter = document.getElementById('ep2_table_counter');
        if (counter) counter.innerText = tasks.length + ' db';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!tasks.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:#64748b;">Nincs a feltételeknek megfelelő feladat.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = tasks.slice(0, 150).map(t => {
            const ratio = parseInt(t.done_ratio || 0);
            const isClosed = (t.status || '').toLowerCase().includes('zárt') || (t.status || '').toLowerCase().includes('kész');
            const statusBg = isClosed ? '#dcfce7' : '#e0f2fe';
            const statusColor = isClosed ? '#15803d' : '#0369a1';

            return `
            <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; font-weight:700; color:#0f172a;">#${t.id}</td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#475569;">${t.project_name || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px;">
                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="openEp2DetailModal(${t.id})" style="font-weight:600; color:#0284c7; text-decoration:none;">
                        ${t.subject || 'Névtelen feladat'}
                    </a>
                </td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">${t.tracker || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; font-size:12.5px; color:#334155;">${t.assigned_to || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px;">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        <div style="flex:1; height:6px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;">
                            <div style="width:${ratio}%; height:100%; background:${ratio === 100 ? '#16a34a' : '#0284c7'};"></div>
                        </div>
                        <span style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:#475569; width:30px;">${ratio}%</span>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">${t.due_date || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px;">
                    <span style="background:${statusBg}; color:${statusColor}; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">
                        ${t.status || 'Nyitott'}
                    </span>
                </td>
                <td style="padding:9px 12px; text-align:center;">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="openEp2DetailModal(${t.id})" style="padding:3px 8px; font-size:11px;">
                        Megnyitás
                    </button>
                </td>
            </tr>
            `;
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterEp2Table = function() {
        const pSel = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_project')?.value || 'ALL';
        const sSel = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_status')?.value || 'ALL';
        const tSel = document.getElementById('ep2_filter_tracker')?.value || 'ALL';
        const q = (document.getElementById('ep2_search_input')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

        const filtered = window.ep2RawTasks.filter(t => {
            if (pSel !== 'ALL' && t.project_name !== pSel) return false;
            if (sSel !== 'ALL' && t.status !== sSel) return false;
            if (tSel !== 'ALL' && t.tracker !== tSel) return false;
            if (q) {
                const text = ((t.subject || '') + ' ' + (t.assigned_to || '') + ' ' + (t.project_name || '') + ' ' + (t.id || '')).toLowerCase();
                if (!text.includes(q)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        renderEp2Table(filtered);
    };

    window.openEp2DetailModal = function(taskId) {
        const task = window.ep2RawTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
        if (!task) return;

        document.getElementById('ep2_modal_title').innerText = `Feladat #${task.id}: ${task.subject || ''}`;
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_project').innerText = task.project_name || '-';
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_assignee').innerText = task.assigned_to || 'Nincs kiosztva';
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_priority').innerText = task.priority || 'Normál';
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_status').innerText = task.status || 'Nyitott';
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_due').innerText = task.due_date || '-';
        document.getElementById('ep2_m_desc').innerText = task.description || 'Nincs részletes leírás rögzítve.';

        const solBox = document.getElementById('ep2_m_solution_box');
        const solTxt = document.getElementById('ep2_m_solution');
        if (task.solution_html && task.solution_html.trim() !== '') {
            solBox.style.display = 'block';
            solTxt.innerHTML = task.solution_html;
        } else {
            solBox.style.display = 'none';
        }

        const modal = document.getElementById('ep2_detail_modal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'block';
    };

    window.closeEp2Modal = function() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('ep2_detail_modal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    };

    window.triggerEp2Sync = async function() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn_ep2_sync_now');
        const fb = document.getElementById('ep2_sync_feedback');
        if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ Szinkronizálás...'; btn.disabled = true; }
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#16a34a; font-weight:700;">⏳ Teljes Easy Project szinkronizáció folyamatban...</span>';

        try {
            const resp = await fetch('/api/settings/sync-ep-now', { method: 'POST' });
            const d = await resp.json();
            if (fb) {
                fb.innerHTML = d.status === 'SUCCESS' 
                    ? '✅ Szinkron kész! Frissítve a táblázat.' 
                    : '❌ Hiba a szinkronkor: ' + (d.message || '-');
            }
            window.loadEasyProject2Data();
        } catch(e) {
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#b91c1c;">❌ Hiba: ' + e.message + '</span>';
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⚡ Teljes EP Szinkron'; btn.disabled = false; }
        }
    };

    // Fülváltó integráció: ha a menüből vagy kódból easy_project-et hívnak
    const prevSwitch = window.switchTab;
    window.switchTab = function(name) {
        if (name === 'easy_project' || name === 'easy_project2' || name === 'tab-easy_project') {
            window.activateEasyProject2Tab();
            return;
        }
        if (typeof prevSwitch === 'function') {
            prevSwitch(name);
        }
    };
})();
</script>

```

```html
    <!-- Fülkezelő és azonnali alkalmazási logika -->
    <script>
    (function() {
        const CONTROLLED_TABS = [
            'dashboard', 'users', 'ad_changes', 'helpdesk',
            'easy_project', 'sync', 'telemetry', 'history',
            'backups', 'ai'
        ];

        function getNavButtonsForTab(tabKey) {
            const matches = new Set();
            // Keresés ID és data-tab alapján
            const selectors = [
                `#tab_btn_${tabKey}`,
                `#tab_btn_${tabKey}2`,
                `[data-tab="${tabKey}"]`,
                `[data-tab="${tabKey}2"]`,
                `[data-tab="tab-${tabKey}"]`
            ];
            selectors.forEach(s => {
                document.querySelectorAll(s).forEach(el => matches.add(el));
            });

            // Keresés onclick függvényhívások alapján
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .app-nav-btn, button').forEach(el => {
                const oc = el.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
                if (oc.includes(`switchTab('${tabKey}')`) || oc.includes(`switchTab("${tabKey}")`) ||
                    oc.includes(`switchTab('${tabKey}2')`) || oc.includes(`switchTab("${tabKey}2")`) ||
                    oc.toLowerCase().includes(`activate${tabKey.replace('_','')}tab`)) {
                    matches.add(el);
                }
            });
            return Array.from(matches);
        }

        window.applyTabVisibility = function(visibilityMap) {
            if (!visibilityMap) return;

            CONTROLLED_TABS.forEach(key => {
                const isVisible = visibilityMap[key] !== false;
                const buttons = getNavButtonsForTab(key);
                buttons.forEach(btn => {
                    btn.style.display = isVisible ? '' : 'none';
                });

                // Ha az aktív fül lett elrejtve, átváltunk a beállításokra
                if (!isVisible) {
                    const panel = document.getElementById(key) || document.getElementById(key + '2') || document.getElementById('tab-' + key);
                    if (panel && (panel.classList.contains('active') || panel.style.display === 'block')) {
                        if (typeof window.switchTab === 'function') {
                            window.switchTab('settings');
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        };

        window.loadTabVisibilityToUI = function() {
            let vis = {};
            try {
                const local = localStorage.getItem('ad_tracker_tab_visibility');
                if (local) vis = JSON.parse(local);
            } catch(e) {}

            CONTROLLED_TABS.forEach(key => {
                const chk = document.getElementById('tvis_' + key);
                if (chk) {
                    chk.checked = vis[key] !== false;
                }
            });
            window.applyTabVisibility(vis);
        };

        window.saveTabVisibilitySettings = async function() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn_save_tab_vis');
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('status_tab_visibility');
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ Mentés...'; btn.disabled = true; }

            const visMap = {};
            CONTROLLED_TABS.forEach(key => {
                const chk = document.getElementById('tvis_' + key);
                visMap[key] = chk ? chk.checked : true;
            });

            // 1. Azonnali helyi alkalmazás
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('ad_tracker_tab_visibility', JSON.stringify(visMap));
            } catch(e) {}
            window.applyTabVisibility(visMap);

            // 2. Mentés a backend adatbázisba/beállításokba
            try {
                const resp = await fetch('/api/settings/save', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ tab_visibility: visMap })
                });
                const d = await resp.json();

                if (statusEl) {
                    statusEl.style.display = 'block';
                    statusEl.style.background = '#dcfce7';
                    statusEl.style.color = '#15803d';
                    statusEl.style.border = '1px solid #bbf7d0';
                    statusEl.innerHTML = '✅ <b>Sikeres mentés:</b> A kiválasztott lapfülek állapota azonnal érvénybe lépett!';
                    setTimeout(() => { statusEl.style.display = 'none'; }, 5000);
                }
            } catch(e) {
                if (statusEl) {
                    statusEl.style.display = 'block';
                    statusEl.style.background = '#fee2e2';
                    statusEl.style.color = '#b91c1c';
                    statusEl.style.border = '1px solid #fecaca';
                    statusEl.innerHTML = '⚠️ <b>Helyi mentés kész,</b> de a szerver nem válaszolt: ' + e.message;
                }
            } finally {
                if (btn) { btn.innerText = '💾 Beállítások Mentése & Alkalmazása'; btn.disabled = false; }
            }
        };

        // Automatikus inicializálás induláskor
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            window.loadTabVisibilityToUI();
        });
        window.loadTabVisibilityToUI();

        // Integráció a meglévő beállításbetöltővel
        const oldUnified = window.loadUnifiedSettings;
        window.loadUnifiedSettings = async function() {
            if (typeof oldUnified === 'function') {
                try { await oldUnified(); } catch(e) {}
            }
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/settings');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data.tab_visibility && Object.keys(data.tab_visibility).length > 0) {
                        localStorage.setItem('ad_tracker_tab_visibility', JSON.stringify(data.tab_visibility));
                        window.loadTabVisibilityToUI();
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        };
    })();
    </script>

<script id="settings-cards-runtime-script">

// ==========================================================================
// AD TRACKER - BEÁLLÍTÁSOK KÁRTYÁK MŰVELETI MOTORJA
// ==========================================================================

window.toggleSecretVisibility = function(id, btn) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.type === 'password') {
        el.type = 'text';
        if (btn) btn.innerText = '🙈';
    } else {
        el.type = 'password';
        if (btn) btn.innerText = '👁️';
    }
};

window.showCardStatus = function(elemId, msg, isSuccess) {
    var el = document.getElementById(elemId);
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.display = 'block';
    el.style.background = isSuccess ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
    el.style.color = isSuccess ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
    el.style.border = isSuccess ? '1px solid #bbf7d0' : '1px solid #fecaca';
    el.innerHTML = msg;
};

window.loadUnifiedSettings = async function() {
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        var d = await res.json();

        var ad = d.ad || {};
        var ep = d.easyproject || {};
        var tg = d.telegram || {};
        var gh = d.github || {};

        var setVal = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && v !== undefined && v !== null) el.value = v; };
        var setChk = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.checked = Boolean(v); };

        setVal('cfg_ad_server', ad.server || 'dc1.tspc.hu:389');
        setVal('cfg_ad_base_dn', ad.base_dn || 'DC=tspc,DC=hu');
        setVal('cfg_ad_user', ad.bind_user || 'tadmin@tspc.hu');
        setVal('cfg_ad_password', ad.bind_password || '');
        setVal('cfg_ad_interval', String(ad.sync_interval_minutes || 15));

        setVal('cfg_ep_url', ep.url || 'https://ep.tspc.hu/');
        setVal('cfg_ep_project', ep.project_id || '2403');
        setVal('cfg_ep_api_key', ep.api_key || '');
        setVal('cfg_ep_interval', String(ep.sync_interval_minutes || 15));

        setVal('cfg_tg_token', tg.bot_token || '');
        setVal('cfg_tg_chat_id', tg.chat_id || '229087988');
        setChk('cfg_tg_notify_hd', tg.notify_helpdesk !== false);
        setChk('cfg_tg_notify_audit', tg.notify_audit !== false);

        setVal('cfg_git_repo', gh.repo_url || 'https://github.com/tspcit/ad-tracker.git');
        setVal('cfg_git_token', gh.token || '');
        setVal('cfg_git_branch', gh.branch || 'main');

        if (window.testGitCard) {
            window.testGitCard(true);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Hiba a kártyák betöltésekor:', e);
    }
};

window.testGitCard = async function(isSilent) {
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_git');
    if (btn && !isSilent) btn.innerText = '⏳ Lekérdezés...';
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/test-git', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                repo_url: document.getElementById('cfg_git_repo')?.value || '',
                token: document.getElementById('cfg_git_token')?.value || ''
            })
        });
        var d = await res.json();

        var setTxt = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerText = v || '-'; };
        setTxt('git_info_tag', d.version || 'v1.10');
        setTxt('git_info_name', d.name || 'Release');
        setTxt('git_info_date', d.date || '-');
        setTxt('git_info_commit', d.commit || '-');
        setTxt('git_info_source', d.source || 'GitHub API');

        if (!isSilent) {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '✅ ' + d.message, true);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (!isSilent) {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Hiba a GitHub lekérdezésekor: ' + e.message, false);
        }
    } finally {
        if (btn && !isSilent) btn.innerText = '🚀 Git Tesztelése';
    }
};

window.pushGitCard = async function() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn_push_git');
    var repoUrl = document.getElementById('cfg_git_repo')?.value || '';
    var token = document.getElementById('cfg_git_token')?.value || '';
    var branch = document.getElementById('cfg_git_branch')?.value || 'main';
    var comment = document.getElementById('cfg_git_comment')?.value || '';

    if (!token) {
        window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Kérjük írja be a Personal Access Token-t (PAT) a push indítása előtt!', false);
        return;
    }

    if (btn) {
        btn.innerText = '⏳ Push (+0.01)...';
        btn.disabled = true;
    }
    window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '⏳ Verziószám növelése, commit, tag címkézés és GitHub Push folyamatban...', true);

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/github-push', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ repo_url: repoUrl, token: token, branch: branch, comment: comment })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        if (d.status === 'SUCCESS') {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '✅ ' + d.message, true);

            var setTxt = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerText = v || '-'; };
            setTxt('git_info_tag', d.version);
            setTxt('git_info_name', d.name);
            setTxt('git_info_date', d.date);
            setTxt('git_info_commit', d.commit || '-');
            setTxt('git_info_source', 'GitHub Távoli Tároló (Frissítve)');

            var commentEl = document.getElementById('cfg_git_comment');
            if (commentEl) commentEl.value = '';
        } else {
            window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ ' + d.message, false);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        window.showCardStatus('status_git_card', '❌ Hálózati hiba a push során: ' + e.message, false);
    } finally {
        if (btn) {
            btn.innerText = '⬆️ GitHub Push (+0.01)';
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
};

window.runDebugCmd = async function(cmd) {
    var inputEl = document.getElementById('unified_debug_input');
    var term = document.getElementById('unified_debug_output');
    var commandToRun = cmd || (inputEl ? inputEl.value : '');
    if (!commandToRun) return;

    if (term) term.innerText += '\n$ ' + commandToRun + '\n⏳ Végrehajtás...';
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/settings/debug-exec', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ command: commandToRun })
        });
        var d = await res.json();
        if (term) {
            term.innerText += '\n' + (d.output || d.message || '') + '\n';
            term.scrollTop = term.scrollHeight;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (term) term.innerText += '\n❌ Hiba: ' + e.message + '\n';
    }
};

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.loadUnifiedSettings);
} else {
    window.loadUnifiedSettings();
}

</script>
```
