          <span style="display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; background:#22c55e; border-radius:50%;"></span>
          <span style="font-size:13px; font-weight:bold; color:#e2e8f0;">Élő Terminál Konzol</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
          <button onclick="clearSyncTerminal()" style="background:#1e293b; color:#cbd5e1; border:1px solid #475569; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer;">Ürítés</button>
          <button onclick="copySyncTerminal()" style="background:#1e293b; color:#cbd5e1; border:1px solid #475569; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer;">Másolás</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="sync-terminal-body" style="height:360px; overflow-y:auto; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; color:#94a3b8;">
        <div>[SZERVER] Szinkronizációs konzol készenlétben...</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. AL-FÜL: STATISZTIKÁK -->
  <div id="sync-tab-pane-stats" class="sync-tab-pane" style="display:none;">
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap:16px;">
      
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:10px; padding:16px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">ÖSSZES FUTTATÁS</div>
        <div id="stat-total-runs" style="font-size:28px; font-weight:800; color:#0f172a;">-</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:10px; padding:16px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">SIKERESSÉGI RÁTA</div>
        <div id="stat-success-rate" style="font-size:28px; font-weight:800; color:#16a34a;">-</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:10px; padding:16px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">ÁTLAGOS FUTÁSIDŐ</div>
        <div id="stat-avg-duration" style="font-size:28px; font-weight:800; color:#0284c7;">-</div>
      </div>

      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:10px; padding:16px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">AD / EP MEGOSZLÁS</div>
        <div id="stat-split" style="font-size:18px; font-weight:800; color:#475569; margin-top:8px;">-</div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<style>
@keyframes sync-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
</style>

<script>
function switchSyncSubtab(tabName) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.sync-tab-pane').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.sync-subtab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.style.background = '#ffffff';
    btn.style.color = '#475569';
    btn.style.border = '1px solid #cbd5e1';
  });
  const targetPane = document.getElementById('sync-tab-pane-' + tabName);
  const targetBtn = document.getElementById('sync-btn-' + tabName);
  if (targetPane) targetPane.style.display = 'block';
  if (targetBtn) {
    targetBtn.style.background = '#0284c7';
    targetBtn.style.color = '#ffffff';
    targetBtn.style.border = 'none';
  }
}

function logToTerminal(msg) {
  const tb = document.getElementById('sync-terminal-body');
  if (!tb) return;
  const d = new Date().toTimeString().split(' ')[0];
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#64748b;">[${d}]</span> ${msg}`;
  tb.appendChild(div);
  tb.scrollTop = tb.scrollHeight;
}

function clearSyncTerminal() {
  const tb = document.getElementById('sync-terminal-body');
  if (tb) tb.innerHTML = '<div>[SZERVER] Napló ürítve.</div>';
}

function copySyncTerminal() {
  const tb = document.getElementById('sync-terminal-body');
  if (!tb) return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(tb.innerText).then(() => alert('Napló kimásolva a vágólapra!'));
}

async function loadSyncStatus() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/status');
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.status === 'SUCCESS') {
      document.getElementById('ad-last-run').innerText = data.ad_sync.last_run;
      document.getElementById('ad-duration').innerText = data.ad_sync.duration;
      document.getElementById('ad-changes').innerText = data.ad_sync.changes + ' db';
      document.getElementById('ep-last-run').innerText = data.ep_sync.last_run;
      document.getElementById('ep-duration').innerText = data.ep_sync.duration;
      document.getElementById('ep-changes').innerText = data.ep_sync.changes + ' db';
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function loadSyncHistory() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/history');
    const data = await res.json();
    const tbody = document.getElementById('sync-history-tbody');
    if (!tbody || !data.logs) return;
    if (data.logs.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#94a3b8;">Nincs előzmény.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    let html = '';
    data.logs.forEach(l => {
      const isSuccess = l.status === 'Sikeres';
      const badge = isSuccess ? 'background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d;' : 'background:#fee2e2; color:#dc2626;';
      html += `<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
        <td style="padding:10px; font-family:monospace; font-weight:bold;">${l.id}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${l.source}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${l.start_time}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;">${l.duration}</td>
        <td style="padding:10px;"><span style="background:#f1f5f9; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;">${l.trigger}</span></td>
        <td style="padding:10px;"><span style="padding:2px 8px; border-radius:12px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; ${badge}">${l.status}</span></td>
        <td style="padding:10px; color:#64748b;">${l.details || '-'}</td>
      </tr>`;
    });
    tbody.innerHTML = html;
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function loadSyncStats() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/stats');
    const d = await res.json();
    if (d.status === 'SUCCESS') {
      document.getElementById('stat-total-runs').innerText = d.total_executions;
      document.getElementById('stat-success-rate').innerText = d.success_rate;
      document.getElementById('stat-avg-duration').innerText = d.avg_duration_sec + ' mp';
      document.getElementById('stat-split').innerText = `${d.total_ad_runs} AD / ${d.total_ep_runs} EP`;
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function triggerSpecificSync(target) {
  const banner = document.getElementById('sync-running-banner');
  const txt = document.getElementById('sync-running-text');
  if (banner) banner.style.display = 'flex';
  if (txt) txt.innerText = `${target === 'ALL' ? 'Teljes' : target} szinkronizáció folyamatban...`;
  logToTerminal(`Szinkronizáció elindítva [${target}]...`);

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/trigger', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({target: target})
    });
    const d = await res.json();
    logToTerminal(`Szinkron lefutott (${d.duration_sec} mp). Eredmény: ${JSON.stringify(d.results)}`);
  } catch(err) {
    logToTerminal(`Hiba a szinkronizáció során: ${err.message}`);
  } finally {
    if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
    refreshSyncAllData();
  }
}

function filterSyncHistoryTable() {
  const input = document.getElementById('sync-history-filter');
  const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#sync-history-tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(r => {
    r.style.display = r.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(filter) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

function refreshSyncAllData() {
  loadSyncStatus();
  loadSyncHistory();
  loadSyncStats();
  const c = document.getElementById('sync-live-clock');
  if (c) c.innerText = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

// Inicializálás betöltéskor
refreshSyncAllData();
setInterval(() => {
  const c = document.getElementById('sync-live-clock');
  if (c) c.innerText = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}, 1000);
</script>

```

<!-- Önálló, beágyazott működési logika -->
<script>
(function() {
    window.sync2RawLogs = [];

    window.activateSync2Tab = function() {
        // Minden fül és tartalom inaktiválása
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .app-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.content').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('active');
            c.style.display = 'none';
        });

        // Sync2 aktiválása
        const btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_sync2');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

        const panel = document.getElementById('sync2');
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
            panel.style.display = 'block';
        }

        window.loadSync2Data();
    };

    window.loadSync2Data = async function() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('sync2_table_body');
        if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:18px; color:#64748b;">⏳ Adatok frissítése az API-ról...</td></tr>';

        try {
            // 1. Státusz és KPI-k
            const stResp = await fetch('/api/sync/status');
            if (stResp.ok) {
                const stData = await stResp.json();
                renderS2Kpi(stData);
            }

            // 2. Naplóadatok lekérése
            const hResp = await fetch('/api/sync/history');
            if (hResp.ok) {
                const hData = await hResp.json();
                window.sync2RawLogs = hData.logs || hData.history || [];
                renderS2Table(window.sync2RawLogs);
            } else {
                if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:15px;">❌ Hiba: Az API nem elérhető (HTTP ' + hResp.status + ')</td></tr>';
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; color:#dc2626; padding:15px;">❌ Lekérési hiba: ' + e.message + '</td></tr>';
        }
    };

    function renderS2Kpi(d) {
        if (!d) return;
        const ad = d.ad_sync || {};
        const ep = d.ep_sync || {};

        const adOk = (ad.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');
        const epOk = (ep.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');

        const elAdRun = document.getElementById('s2_ad_last_run');
        if (elAdRun) elAdRun.innerText = ad.last_run || '-';
        const elAdChg = document.getElementById('s2_ad_changes');
        if (elAdChg) elAdChg.innerText = (ad.changes !== undefined ? ad.changes : '-') + ' db';
        const elAdDur = document.getElementById('s2_ad_duration');
        if (elAdDur) elAdDur.innerText = ad.duration || '-';
        const elAdBadge = document.getElementById('s2_ad_status_badge');
        if (elAdBadge) {
            elAdBadge.innerText = ad.status || 'NINCS ADAT';
            elAdBadge.style.background = adOk ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
            elAdBadge.style.color = adOk ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
        }

        const elEpRun = document.getElementById('s2_ep_last_run');
        if (elEpRun) elEpRun.innerText = ep.last_run || '-';
        const elEpChg = document.getElementById('s2_ep_changes');
        if (elEpChg) elEpChg.innerText = (ep.changes !== undefined ? ep.changes : '-') + ' db';
        const elEpDur = document.getElementById('s2_ep_duration');
        if (elEpDur) elEpDur.innerText = ep.duration || '-';
        const elEpBadge = document.getElementById('s2_ep_status_badge');
        if (elEpBadge) {
            elEpBadge.innerText = ep.status || 'NINCS ADAT';
            elEpBadge.style.background = epOk ? '#dcfce7' : '#fee2e2';
            elEpBadge.style.color = epOk ? '#15803d' : '#b91c1c';
        }
    }

    function renderS2Table(logs) {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('sync2_table_body');
        const counter = document.getElementById('s2_row_counter');
        if (counter) counter.innerText = logs.length + ' bejegyzés';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!logs.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:18px; color:#64748b;">Nincs megjeleníthető szinkron naplóbejegyzés.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = logs.map(l => {
            const isAd = (l.source || '').includes('Active Directory');
            const isOk = (l.status || '').toLowerCase().includes('siker');

            const srcBadge = isAd 
                ? '<span style="background:#e0f2fe; color:#0369a1; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; font-size:11px;">🏢 Active Directory</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#f3e8ff; color:#7e22ce; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; font-size:11px;">🎫 Easy Project</span>';

            const stBadge = isOk
                ? '<span style="background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">Sikeres</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">Hiba</span>';

            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px;">' + srcBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#334155;">' + (l.started_at || l.start_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px; color:#64748b;">' + (l.duration || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#475569;">' + (l.trigger || l.trigger_type || 'Kézi') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px;">' + stBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:9px 12px; color:#1e293b;">' + (l.details || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterSync2Table = function() {
        const srcFilter = (document.getElementById('s2_filter_source')?.value || 'ALL');
        const q = (document.getElementById('s2_search_input')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

        const filtered = window.sync2RawLogs.filter(l => {
            if (srcFilter === 'AD' && !(l.source || '').includes('Active Directory')) return false;
            if (srcFilter === 'EP' && !(l.source || '').includes('Easy Project')) return false;
            if (q) {
                const text = ((l.source || '') + ' ' + (l.details || '') + ' ' + (l.trigger || '') + ' ' + (l.status || '')).toLowerCase();
                if (!text.includes(q)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        renderS2Table(filtered);
    };

    window.triggerS2AdSync = async function() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn_s2_sync_ad');
        const fb = document.getElementById('s2_action_feedback');
        if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ AD Kinyerés folyamatban...'; btn.disabled = true; }
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#0284c7; font-weight:600;">⏳ Élő AD szinkronizálás indítva...</span>';

        try {
            const resp = await fetch('/api/settings/sync-ad-now', { method: 'POST' });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = data.status === 'SUCCESS' ? '✅ AD kinyerés sikeresen lefutott!' : '❌ Hiba: ' + (data.message || 'Hiba történt');
            window.loadSync2Data();
        } catch(e) {
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#b91c1c;">❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + e.message + '</span>';
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⚡ AD Kinyerés Most'; btn.disabled = false; }
        }
    };

    window.triggerS2EpSync = async function() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn_s2_sync_ep');
        const fb = document.getElementById('s2_action_feedback');
        if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⏳ EP Szinkronizálás...'; btn.disabled = true; }
        if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#16a34a; font-weight:600;">⏳ Easy Project szinkron indítva...</span>';

        try {
            const resp = await fetch('/api/settings/sync-ep-now', { method: 'POST' });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = data.status === 'SUCCESS' ? '✅ EP szinkron sikeresen lefutott!' : '❌ Hiba: ' + (data.message || 'Hiba történt');
            window.loadSync2Data();
        } catch(e) {
            if (fb) fb.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#b91c1c;">❌ Hálózati hiba: ' + e.message + '</span>';
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.innerText = '⚡ EP Szinkron Most'; btn.disabled = false; }
        }
    };

    // Kiterjesztjük a meglévő switchTab logikát, hogy ezt a fület is kezelje
    const prevSwitch = window.switchTab;
    window.switchTab = function(name) {
        if (name === 'sync2' || name === 'tab-sync2') {
            window.activateSync2Tab();
            return;
        }
        if (typeof prevSwitch === 'function') {
            prevSwitch(name);
        }
    };
})();
</script>

<script id="telemetry-runtime-engine">
(function() {
    window.telemetryRawLogs = [];
    window.telemetryTimer = null;

    window.toggleTelemetryAutoRefresh = function() {
        var chk = document.getElementById('t_auto_refresh_chk');
        if (window.telemetryTimer) {
            clearInterval(window.telemetryTimer);
            window.telemetryTimer = null;
        }
        if (chk && chk.checked) {
            window.telemetryTimer = setInterval(function() {
                var p = document.getElementById('pane-telemetry');
                if (p && (p.classList.contains('active') || p.style.display === 'block')) {
                    window.loadTelemetryData();
                }
            }, 10000);
        }
    };

    window.loadTelemetryData = async function() {
        // 1. Live Hardver Metrikák
        try {
            var rLive = await fetch('/api/telemetry/live');
            if (rLive.ok) {
                var dLive = await rLive.json();
                renderTelemetryKpis(dLive);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Live hiba:', e);
        }

        // 2. Munkamenetek
        try {
            var rSess = await fetch('/api/telemetry/sessions');
            if (rSess.ok) {
                var dSess = await rSess.json();
                renderTelemetrySessions(dSess.sessions || []);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Munkamenet hiba:', e);
        }

        // 3. Web Access Logs
        try {
            var rLogs = await fetch('/api/telemetry/access-logs');
            if (!rLogs.ok) rLogs = await fetch('/api/telemetry/web-logs');
            if (rLogs.ok) {
                var dLogs = await rLogs.json();
                window.telemetryRawLogs = dLogs.logs || [];
                renderTelemetryLogs(window.telemetryRawLogs);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria Web log hiba:', e);
        }
    };

    function renderTelemetryKpis(d) {
        if (!d) return;

        var cpuPct = d.cpu_percent !== undefined ? d.cpu_percent : 0;
        var elCpuP = document.getElementById('t_cpu_percent');
        if (elCpuP) elCpuP.innerText = cpuPct + '%';
        var elCpuC = document.getElementById('t_cpu_cores');
        if (elCpuC) elCpuC.innerText = '(' + (d.cpu_cores || 4) + ' mag)';
        var elCpuL = document.getElementById('t_cpu_load');
        if (elCpuL) elCpuL.innerText = d.cpu_load_avg || '-';
        var elCpuB = document.getElementById('t_cpu_bar');
        if (elCpuB) {
            elCpuB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, cpuPct)) + '%';
            elCpuB.style.background = cpuPct > 80 ? '#dc2626' : (cpuPct > 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#0284c7');
        }

        var ramPct = d.ram_percent !== undefined ? d.ram_percent : 0;
        var elRamP = document.getElementById('t_ram_percent');
        if (elRamP) elRamP.innerText = ramPct + '%';
        var elRamR = document.getElementById('t_ram_ratio');
        if (elRamR) elRamR.innerText = '(' + (d.ram_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.ram_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        var elRamF = document.getElementById('t_ram_free');
        if (elRamF) elRamF.innerText = (d.ram_free_gb || 0) + ' GB';
        var elRamB = document.getElementById('t_ram_bar');
        if (elRamB) {
            elRamB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ramPct)) + '%';
            elRamB.style.background = ramPct > 85 ? '#dc2626' : (ramPct > 65 ? '#f59e0b' : '#16a34a');
        }

        var diskPct = d.disk_percent !== undefined ? d.disk_percent : 0;
        var elDiskP = document.getElementById('t_disk_percent');
        if (elDiskP) elDiskP.innerText = diskPct + '%';
        var elDiskR = document.getElementById('t_disk_ratio');
        if (elDiskR) elDiskR.innerText = '(' + (d.disk_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.disk_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        var elDbSz = document.getElementById('t_db_size');
        if (elDbSz) elDbSz.innerText = (d.db_size_mb || 0) + ' MB';
        var elDbCn = document.getElementById('t_db_conns');
        if (elDbCn) elDbCn.innerText = (d.db_connections !== undefined ? d.db_connections : '-');
        var elDiskB = document.getElementById('t_disk_bar');
        if (elDiskB) elDiskB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, diskPct)) + '%';

        var elUp = document.getElementById('t_uptime');
        if (elUp) elUp.innerText = d.uptime_str || (d.uptime_hours ? d.uptime_hours + ' óra' : '-');
        var elIp = document.getElementById('t_host_ip');
        if (elIp) elIp.innerText = d.host_ip || '-';
        var elGpu = document.getElementById('t_gpu_name');
        if (elGpu) elGpu.innerText = d.gpu_name || 'N/A (CPU Mód)';
        var elUsr = document.getElementById('t_cur_user');
        if (elUsr) elUsr.innerText = d.current_user?.name || 'tadmin';
    }

    function renderTelemetrySessions(sessions) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('t_sessions_tbody');
        var count = document.getElementById('t_sessions_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = sessions.length + ' db';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!sessions.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs aktív munkamenet.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = sessions.map(function(s) {
            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><b>👤 ' + (s.username || '-') + '</b></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-family:monospace; color:#334155;">' + (s.client_ip || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#64748b;">' + (s.login_time || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-weight:600; color:#0f172a;">' + (s.last_activity || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#475569;">' + (s.os_name || '-') + ' (' + (s.device_type || 'Desktop') + ')</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">' + (s.browser || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderTelemetryLogs(logs) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('t_logs_tbody');
        var count = document.getElementById('t_logs_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = logs.length + ' esemény';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!logs.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs naplóbejegyzés.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = logs.slice(0, 80).map(function(l) {
            var isOk = (l.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');
            var stBadge = isOk 
                ? '<span style="background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">SIKERES</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">HIBA</span>';

            return '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-weight:600; color:#334155;">' + (l.timestamp || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><b>' + (l.username || '-') + '</b></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; font-family:monospace; color:#475569;">' + (l.client_ip || '-') + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;"><span style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#0f172a; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600;">' + (l.action || '-') + '</span></td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px;">' + stBadge + '</td>' +
                '<td style="padding:8px 10px; color:#334155;">' + (l.details || '-') + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterTelemetryLogs = function() {
        var q = (document.getElementById('t_log_search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (!q) {
            renderTelemetryLogs(window.telemetryRawLogs);
            return;
        }
        var filtered = window.telemetryRawLogs.filter(function(l) {
            var text = ((l.username || '') + ' ' + (l.client_ip || '') + ' ' + (l.action || '') + ' ' + (l.details || '') + ' ' + (l.timestamp || '')).toLowerCase();
            return text.includes(q);
        });
        renderTelemetryLogs(filtered);
    };

    // Fülváltás eseményfigyelő (CAPTURE): ha a Telemetria gombra kattintanak, azonnal lekéri az adatokat
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('button');
        if (!btn) return;
        var txt = btn.textContent || btn.innerText || '';
        var oc = btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
        if (txt.includes('Telemetria') || oc.includes('telemetry')) {
            setTimeout(window.loadTelemetryData, 50);
        }
    }, true);

    // Oldalinduláskor azonnal lekéri a háttérben
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        window.loadTelemetryData();
    });

    // Azonnali hívás
    setTimeout(window.loadTelemetryData, 150);
})();
</script>

<!-- Telemetria v2 önálló motor -->
<script>
(function() {
    window.t2RawLogs = [];
    window.t2Timer = null;

    window.activateTelemetry2Tab = function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .app-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.content').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('active');
            c.style.display = 'none';
        });

        const btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_telemetry');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

        const panel = document.getElementById('telemetry2');
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
            panel.style.display = 'block';
        }

        window.loadTelemetry2Data();
    };

    window.toggleT2AutoRefresh = function() {
        const chk = document.getElementById('t2_auto_refresh_chk');
        if (window.t2Timer) {
            clearInterval(window.t2Timer);
            window.t2Timer = null;
        }
        if (chk && chk.checked) {
            window.t2Timer = setInterval(() => {
                const panel = document.getElementById('telemetry2');
                if (panel && panel.classList.contains('active')) {
                    window.loadTelemetry2Data();
                }
            }, 10000);
        }
    };

    window.loadTelemetry2Data = async function() {
        // 1. Live Hardver Metrikák
        try {
            const rLive = await fetch('/api/telemetry/live');
            if (rLive.ok) {
                const dLive = await rLive.json();
                renderT2Kpis(dLive);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Telemetria élő lekérési hiba:', e);
        }

        // 2. Munkamenetek
        try {
            const rSess = await fetch('/api/telemetry/sessions');
            if (rSess.ok) {
                const dSess = await rSess.json();
                renderT2Sessions(dSess.sessions || []);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Munkamenet lekérési hiba:', e);
        }

        // 3. Web Access Logs
        try {
            const rLogs = await fetch('/api/telemetry/access-logs');
            if (rLogs.ok) {
                const dLogs = await rLogs.json();
                window.t2RawLogs = dLogs.logs || [];
                renderT2Logs(window.t2RawLogs);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Web log lekérési hiba:', e);
        }
    };

    function renderT2Kpis(d) {
        if (!d) return;

        // CPU
        const cpuPct = d.cpu_percent !== undefined ? d.cpu_percent : 0;
        const elCpuP = document.getElementById('t2_cpu_percent');
        if (elCpuP) elCpuP.innerText = cpuPct + '%';
        const elCpuC = document.getElementById('t2_cpu_cores');
        if (elCpuC) elCpuC.innerText = '(' + (d.cpu_cores || 4) + ' mag)';
        const elCpuL = document.getElementById('t2_cpu_load');
        if (elCpuL) elCpuL.innerText = d.cpu_load_avg || '-';
        const elCpuB = document.getElementById('t2_cpu_bar');
        if (elCpuB) {
            elCpuB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, cpuPct)) + '%';
            elCpuB.style.background = cpuPct > 80 ? '#dc2626' : (cpuPct > 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#0284c7');
        }

        // RAM
        const ramPct = d.ram_percent !== undefined ? d.ram_percent : 0;
        const elRamP = document.getElementById('t2_ram_percent');
        if (elRamP) elRamP.innerText = ramPct + '%';
        const elRamR = document.getElementById('t2_ram_ratio');
        if (elRamR) elRamR.innerText = '(' + (d.ram_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.ram_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        const elRamF = document.getElementById('t2_ram_free');
        if (elRamF) elRamF.innerText = (d.ram_free_gb || 0) + ' GB';
        const elRamB = document.getElementById('t2_ram_bar');
        if (elRamB) {
            elRamB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ramPct)) + '%';
            elRamB.style.background = ramPct > 85 ? '#dc2626' : (ramPct > 65 ? '#f59e0b' : '#16a34a');
        }

        // Tárhely & DB
        const diskPct = d.disk_percent !== undefined ? d.disk_percent : 0;
        const elDiskP = document.getElementById('t2_disk_percent');
        if (elDiskP) elDiskP.innerText = diskPct + '%';
        const elDiskR = document.getElementById('t2_disk_ratio');
        if (elDiskR) elDiskR.innerText = '(' + (d.disk_used_gb || 0) + ' / ' + (d.disk_total_gb || 0) + ' GB)';
        const elDbSz = document.getElementById('t2_db_size');
        if (elDbSz) elDbSz.innerText = (d.db_size_mb || 0) + ' MB';
        const elDbCn = document.getElementById('t2_db_conns');
        if (elDbCn) elDbCn.innerText = (d.db_connections !== undefined ? d.db_connections : '-');
        const elDiskB = document.getElementById('t2_disk_bar');
        if (elDiskB) elDiskB.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, diskPct)) + '%';

        // Host info
        const elUp = document.getElementById('t2_uptime');
        if (elUp) elUp.innerText = d.uptime_str || (d.uptime_hours ? d.uptime_hours + ' óra' : '-');
        const elIp = document.getElementById('t2_host_ip');
        if (elIp) elIp.innerText = d.host_ip || '-';
        const elGpu = document.getElementById('t2_gpu_name');
        if (elGpu) elGpu.innerText = d.gpu_name || 'N/A (CPU Mód)';
        const elUsr = document.getElementById('t2_cur_user');
        if (elUsr) elUsr.innerText = d.current_user?.name || 'tadmin';
    }

    function renderT2Sessions(sessions) {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('t2_sessions_tbody');
        const count = document.getElementById('t2_sessions_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = sessions.length + ' db';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!sessions.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs aktív munkamenet.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = sessions.map(s => `
            <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
                <td style="padding:8px 12px;"><b>👤 ${s.username || '-'}</b></td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; font-family:monospace; color:#334155;">${s.client_ip || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; color:#64748b;">${s.login_time || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#0f172a;">${s.last_activity || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; color:#475569;">${s.os_name || '-'} (${s.device_type || 'Desktop'})</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#64748b;">${s.browser || '-'}</td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
    }

    function renderT2Logs(logs) {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('t2_logs_tbody');
        const count = document.getElementById('t2_logs_count');
        if (count) count.innerText = logs.length + ' esemény';
        if (!tbody) return;

        if (!logs.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#64748b;">Nincs naplóbejegyzés.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = logs.slice(0, 80).map(l => {
            const isOk = (l.status || '').toUpperCase().includes('SIKER');
            const stBadge = isOk 
                ? '<span style="background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">SIKERES</span>'
                : '<span style="background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:700; font-size:11px;">HIBA</span>';

            return `
            <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#334155;">${l.timestamp || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px;"><b>${l.username || '-'}</b></td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; font-family:monospace; color:#475569;">${l.client_ip || '-'}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px;"><span style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#0f172a; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600;">${l.action || '-'}</span></td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px;">${stBadge}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px 12px; color:#334155;">${l.details || '-'}</td>
            </tr>
            `;
        }).join('');
    }

    window.filterT2Logs = function() {
        const q = (document.getElementById('t2_log_search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (!q) {
            renderT2Logs(window.t2RawLogs);
            return;
        }
        const filtered = window.t2RawLogs.filter(l => {
            const text = ((l.username || '') + ' ' + (l.client_ip || '') + ' ' + (l.action || '') + ' ' + (l.details || '') + ' ' + (l.timestamp || '')).toLowerCase();
            return text.includes(q);
        });
        renderT2Logs(filtered);
    };

    // Fülváltó integráció
    const oldSwitch = window.switchTab;
    window.switchTab = function(name) {
        if (name === 'telemetry' || name === 'telemetry2' || name === 'tab-telemetry') {
            window.activateTelemetry2Tab();
            return;
        }
        if (name === 'sync' || name === 'sync2' || name === 'tab-sync') {
            if (typeof window.activateSync2Tab === 'function') {
                window.activateSync2Tab();
                return;
            }
        }
        if (typeof oldSwitch === 'function') {
            oldSwitch(name);
        }
    };
})();
</script>

```
